name: triage-worker-python
description: Python SDK starter for a local triage worker that combines a published AgentPM agent with one extra direct tool.

variables.name: project_name
variables.description: Generated project name. Generation-time only; do not use for API keys, tokens, passwords, or runtime secrets.

variables.name: worker_label
variables.description: Human-readable label used in the generated README and terminal banner.

variables.name: team_name
variables.description: Team name referenced in the generated README, prompts, and system instructions.

variables.name: input_path
variables.description: Default local incident fixture path referenced in the generated README and runtime prompt examples.

entrypoints.label: Run the triage worker
entrypoints.command: uv run python -m dotenv -f .env.local run -- python -m app.main

entrypoints.label: Run the scaffold tests
entrypoints.command: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
